properties.name: Cache media files
properties.summary: The system must cache media files to improve load times.
properties.text:
## REQ-1 Cache media files

The system shall cache media files to reduce load times.

properties.name: Upload audio files
properties.summary: Users can upload audio files as per requirement REQ-2.
properties.text:
## REQ-2 Upload audio files

Users shall be able to upload audio files.

properties.name: Encrypt user passwords
properties.summary: The system must store user passwords in encrypted form only.
properties.text:
## REQ-3 Encrypt user passwords

The system shall store user passwords only in encrypted form.

properties.name: Components
properties.summary: The MediaCache component stores recently used media files in memory, while the CredentialStore component manages user accounts and their credentials.
properties.text:
## Components

The MediaCache component keeps recently used media files in memory.
The CredentialStore component stores user accounts and their credentials.

properties.name: requirements.md
properties.text:
# Requirements

## REQ-1 Cache media files

The system shall cache media files to reduce load times.

## REQ-2 Upload audio files

Users shall be able to upload audio files.

## REQ-3 Encrypt user passwords

The system shall store user passwords only in encrypted form.

properties.name: architecture.md
properties.text:
# Architecture

## Components

The MediaCache component keeps recently used media files in memory.
The CredentialStore component stores user accounts and their credentials.
